o: The hour has come. Season 6 captures Jesus' final day through the eyes of those who love Him-and those who condemn Him. In the face of loneliness and death, He stands resolute in His plan that has always led to one place: the cross.

eps.o: Fear and confusion reign as the disciples struggle to make sense of Jesus' arrest-and Judas' betrayal. While they fight to stay together, Nicodemus stands alone against the High Priest in a heated showdown that throws the council into disorder.

Jesus refuses to defend Himself when interrogated by the former High Priest Annas, whose verdict could sway public opinion. Meanwhile, the women make a mad dash for Jerusalem, and Judas tries to rationalize his betrayal to John.

Tension mounts as Caiaphas stages a daring nighttime show trial before an eager jury of Jesus' enemies. As Peter denies Jesus not once, but three times, Judas attempts to set the record straight. Nicodemus prepares his defense-but will he be too late?
